items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What was the blues singer? Blue singer. Who was on that band with drumming?

ctx.x: Then I left Hande's band, I went with Walter Pichon's band, and we played for Mamie Smith on the Vaudeville shows.
What was the blues singer? Blue singer. Who was on that band with drumming?
In that band, Thedo Poinel was on sax, George Clark was on sax, and Botley again was on sax, Edward Botley. Chester Zardes on bass.
